title: Re-verifying screening units keeps the recorded gold verdict
body:
`node evals/units/screening.ts verify` without `--recorded` overwrites `row.verification` with a fresh object, dropping the `gold` field added in #1281 (6f474d2). The 5 units dropped for gold≠0 (t-27osi9b, t-8niclvu, t-bi8r80b, t-1myowwn, t-2blfi57) would then count as verified again although their unit directories are gone. Do not merge while an S7 screen run is live (harness hash).
Outcome: a re-verify of a row with gold=1 keeps gold=1 and the row stays unverified; the regression test passes (exit 0).
Proof: node --test test/evals/screening-units.test.ts exits 0 with a gold-carry-over test.
